HatchPattern__Metal__Meta.Meta__Description: Metal in section - diagonals at 45 degrees in close pairs. The pairing is what tells it from brickwork's evenly spaced diagonals.
HatchPattern__Metal__Meta.Meta__WhyPaperUnits: Every length here is PAPER millimetres, like the dash patterns in Na__LayoutEditor__EdgeStyles__Config__.json, so the hatch measures the same on the sheet at 1:20 and at 1:100. Pattern scale adjusts from there.
HatchPattern__Metal__Meta.Meta__Spacing: Two pairs to a 12 mm tile: 0.85 mm between the lines of a pair and 4.24 mm from pair to pair, measured square to the lines.
HatchPattern__Metal__Meta.Meta__WhySeams: The lines run to the tile's edges and meet their continuation in the next tile exactly. No line passes through a tile CORNER and none runs along an edge: a corner is shared by four tiles and an edge by two, and ink there would need drawing by all of them. Na__LeHatch__SeamCopies paints what a neighbouring tile pushes across a seam, so a line keeps its full width where it crosses, at any line weight.

HatchPattern__Metal__Identity.Identity__Description: How this pattern is named, found and grouped in the pattern lists.
HatchPattern__Metal__Identity.Identity__Note: Steel and other metals cut in section, where the section is big enough to hatch rather than fill solid.

HatchPattern__Metal__Tile.Tile__Description: The repeating cell, in paper millimetres.
HatchPattern__Metal__Tile.Tile__Note: Square, so the diagonals close on themselves.

HatchPattern__Metal__Defaults.Defaults__Description: What the pattern draws with until a use sets its own. The stroke is 0.25 pt (0.0882 mm) at scale 1 and grows with the pattern scale; a line weight typed in the panel does not. 'inherit' takes the colour of whatever carries the hatch - a vector's edge colour - until a pattern colour is picked.

HatchPattern__Metal__Glyphs.Glyphs__Description: Drawn about the glyph's own origin, y pointing DOWN, in tile millimetres. Strokes only: the PDF stamps a tile as lines and never fills one.

Pairs.Glyph__Note: Eight pieces of four endless lines, x + y = 2, 3.2, 8 and 9.2. The nearest any comes to a corner is 1.41 mm.

HatchPattern__Metal__Placements.Place__Note: The whole tile is one glyph at the origin

HatchPattern__Metal__Bounds.Bounds__Description: How far a use may scale and turn this pattern before it stops reading as the material.
